text:
Elena (Growth): Quick thread to lock the tri-mode landing copy + gated benchmark webinar flow. Need copy, routing, and the gated kit plan. Goal: clean signal for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
Marco (PMM): High-level: one short launch post that links to each mode page. Each mode needs 1-sentence hero, 3 bullets, one benchmark teaser, and a clear CTA. Keep it factual, developer-forward.
Jess (Content): Hero roughs: Hosted: "Up and running in minutes." Dedicated: "Throughput with guarantees." Private: "Your inference, your network." Subhead examples: latency-first, commitment-first, compliance-first.
Tariq (Design): I'll make modular hero comps so we can swap headlines quickly for A/B. No raw public numbers. Teaser line: "See verified performance profiles (gated)."
Pri (Sales Ops): Routing rules: Hosted CTA -> product onboarding flow; Dedicated CTA -> AE queue "Reserved-Enterprise"; Private CTA -> security intake form before AE. Add hidden param `mode_hint` to every CTA for fallback routing.
launch-helper: Note: publishing webinar page triggers HubSpot campaign id=tri_mode_launch_2026 and auto-adds utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch to demo links. It will also create form fields: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case.
Jess (Content): CTA microcopy: Hosted: "Start free — no card"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity — talk to sales"; Private: "Request private eval — security first". Under-hero bullets: latency | cost control | deployment modes.
Marco (PMM): Benchmarks: public page = conservative teaser ("verified profiles"). Full p50/p95 and throughput charts in gated kit + webinar. Legal: we need a short methodology blurb in the kit.
Pri (Sales Ops): Webinar form must capture: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket (<10M,10-100M,100M-1B,>1B), primary_use_case (chat/search/agents/embeds). Registrants who pick Dedicated/Private get AE follow-up within 24h. Hosted goes to automated nurture.
Tariq (Design): I'll annotate CTA components with data-cta-id and wire `?mode_hint=hosted|dedicated|private`. Also will create two hero art directions: speed-first and cost-first for the A/B.
Jess (Content): Launch post structure: 1) problem in ~120 words, 2) short explainer of modes, 3) two benchmark teasers, 4) webinar CTA + gated kit. Add tweet-sized blurb for socials.
Elena (Growth): A/B plan: run headline A vs B on Hosted and Dedicated for 10–14 days. Metric: webinar signups + demo clicks; secondary: bounce rate. Experiment details go into the experiment doc.
Marco (PMM): For the gated kit we should include: reproducible test harness, model buckets, latency/throughput plots, and config notes (batching, kv cache). We'll require registrants to accept terms before download.
Pri (Sales Ops): Implementation note: example CTA link pattern for tracking: `https://redwood.com/demo?mode_hint=dedicated&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch` — QA needs to verify mode_hint is persisted if form skipped.
Tariq (Design): Uploading comps by 6pm. Jess please give final hero variants by 11am tomorrow so I can mock both A/B lanes.
Jess (Content): Will drop 6 headline variants (2 per mode) by 11am. Keep verbs consistent (Start / Reserve / Request).
Elena (Growth): Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow 11am PT, design comps by 6pm, QA Wed, soft launch Fri. I'll post the final routing matrix after copy freeze. Last call for edits. :white_check_mark:
